features.name: Grid Sizes
features.description: Provide multiple grid sizes for different difficulty levels such as Beginner (9x9), Intermediate (16x16), and Expert (30x16).

features.name: Flagging System
features.description: Allow players to flag potential mines.

features.name: Timer
features.description: Track the time taken to complete a puzzle.

features.name: Scoreboard
features.description: Record the shortest completion time for each difficulty level.

features.name: User Interface
features.description: Offer an intuitive interface with color-coded indicators based on mine proximity.
